The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations. Through lively food challenges, scenic explorations, and authentic local encounters, the hosts bring audiences closer to Taiwans diverse flavors and vibrant traditions.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Royal Tramp ((鹿鼎记))
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps. (魏晓宝是一个革命团体派来 在皇宫内做间谍 并找到42个分会的天皇)

programme.title: Wu Kong ((悟空传))
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods. (在五百年前, 猴王吴港在天国大浩劫, 电影讲述了吴港 不愿屈从于自己的命运, 如何反抗神灵的故事。)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Someday Or One Day ((想见你))
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny? (这部电影是同一个名字的电视系列片的副产品。 当黄玉须哀悼其男友的去世时,她收到了一个神秘的磁带播放器,允许她及时返回。 她再次见到她的男朋友,但是她能改变他的命运吗?)

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match? (当为流浪少女举办的午夜健身房项目面临资金风险时,社会工作者Yanki召集了一个躲避球队,以比赛为比赛并拯救比赛。 女孩们以前明星运动员John为教练,意识到她们必须面对自己的问题,克服挑战,而不是逃避挑战。 她们最终能够赢得比赛吗?)

programme.title: The Moon Thieves ((从地球到月球 Thieves))
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary Moonwatch. Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist. (一个邪恶的钟表经销商聚集了一个胆大妄为的团队 — — 一个小偷、爆炸专家、断锁者和钟表经纪人 — — 来在东京偷三个奢侈品手表。当他们发现传奇的月表时,他们的任务发生了意外的转折。在黑帮的追赶下,团队必须团结起来,以克服混乱,完成他们高额抢掠。)

programme.title: All Suspects ((全员嫌疑人))
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleutheach guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery. (休假的警察检查了BB,与侦探小说家、无家可归的流浪者和钢琴家共享空间。 但是,当发现主人和接待员死亡时,和平撤退就变成了猜疑和欺骗的网络。 每一位客人都成为嫌疑犯,并隐匿着可能揭开整个谜团的秘密。)

programme.title: Golden Boy ((金童))
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son. (在监狱服刑十年后,前拳击手张立首次见到儿子。 被迫共同生活是为了继承遗产,这是为重建信任而争斗的一对纷争。 当张乐返回拳击场争取救赎的最后一击时,他必须面对过去,与儿子为未来而斗争。)

programme.title: The Sleep Curse ((乱马½))
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translators son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment. (在日本占领香港期间,一位年轻的翻译与敌人勾结,被一位被谋杀的慰安妇诅咒。 四十五年后,一位专门研究睡眠障碍的翻译儿子不相信他父亲的睡眠诅咒,并试图用可怕的睡眠实验来消除这种诅咒。)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive? (在愤怒和悲痛的驱使下,他们开始一场无序的暴力斗争,以追击残酷的贩运集团。 他们能摧毁犯罪团伙,让孩子活着回家吗?)

programme.title: We are Family (我们是家庭)
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way. (作为一个额外的家庭成员,奇加入卡洛斯和望女演员凯瑟琳的租公司,并租自己作为假设的亲戚.)

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You ((不需要爱的夏天))
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens... (Lu Yao患失忆症,忘记了昨天他第二天醒来时发生的一切。当Lu Yao遇到精神治疗师Xing Yue时,尽管知道他们没有共同的未来,他们还是坠入爱河,并决心无论发生什么都彼此相爱。)

programme.title: Way We Talk, The (我们的说法)
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience. (这是关于三个青年的令人深思的故事:沃尔夫、索菲和艾伦,他们各自都生活在不同形式的聋哑中。他们通过手语培养了深厚的友谊并相互提供坚定的支持。 以爱和友谊团结在一起,三重心开始了自我发现和复原力的旅程。)

programme.title: The Monkey King ((美猴王))
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven. (努瓦女神为了拯救凡人世界而牺牲自己之后,猴子王从她的水晶中诞生。 强大和无法控制的猴子王挑战玉帝,在天堂制造暴怒,无意中为邪恶的水牛妖王创造了在天堂发动战争的机会。)

programme.title: Oversteer ((速战人生))
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure. (这部电影从一个真实的故事改编而来,紧随冯。 冯是一位执着的年轻人,他挑战父亲追求成为汽车机械师的梦想。 他和他的童年朋友云一起,踏上了一场大胆的旅程,意外地将他们推入激动人心的赛车世界,引发了一场充满激情的即将到来的冒险。)

programme.title: The Phantom Lover ((夜半歌声))
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community. (1926年,中国有才华的歌手宋英俊深爱着来自富裕家庭的可爱的无辜女孩托,他们的爱激起了托斯父亲的强烈反对,也引起了她指定的未婚夫的强烈嫉妒,未婚夫是她家庭所选择的一位年轻男子。 这是一个关于一名歌手和一个富人女子在传统社区中争吵在一起的故事。)

programme.title: My First of May ((无名指))
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughters pinky finger. (前南瓜冠军邓格及其妻子在被诊断为肌肉萎缩和母亲患癌症时面临毁灭性的考验。 几年后,当家人在坚持和放手之间挣扎时,他们通过一个微小但强大的希望信号找到了新的联系:她们女儿的手指微弱移动。)

programme.title: Beyond The Sin ((宝可梦))
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth. (严督察的唯一女儿被残忍地杀害,而她的同学温同仁也被逮捕了。 相信案件结案后,燕同仁离开警察部队。 但是,当Wen监禁后有更多的女孩被杀时,燕同仁开始怀疑真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外,并发誓寻找真相。)

programme.title: Lelio PoPo (莱利奥波波)
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures. (从前的DJ KK和Ah Luke电台曾经非常受欢迎,但他们的不良态度和以极端为中心的行为使他们被解雇了。 迫不及待地回访,他们为寻找老年女性主机的新电台试镜。 假扮自己是老太太,这对夫妇出乎意料地找到了工作,引发了一系列可笑的冒险。)

programme.title: The Hedgehog ((刺猬索尼克))
programme.desc: Wangs odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wangs only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life. (王氏的奇特行为和古怪思想使他成为社会抛弃者。 他十几岁的侄子周的侄子Zhou为他的扎特感到羞耻,他成为了王氏唯一的朋友。 这些错误加在一起挑战了传统的家庭期望和社会误解,在他们寻找自己的生活道路时相互支持和激励。)

programme.title: The Myth ((西西弗斯的神话))
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny. (考古学家杰克在神秘梦的指引下发现,他过去曾是孟易义将军,与玉洙公主有着长达一千年的悲剧性爱。 当他们重新聚首于秦氏天皇宫时,一位无情的大亨在寻找永生的秘密。 夺回他过去的力量,杰克面临着命运的最后一场战斗。)

programme.title: Pale Passion ((我为你狂))
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back (花芳是一位执着的男人,他爱他的妻子阿霞,但很容易嫉妒和虐待她。有一天,当她离开他时,她和另一个女人Hsing勾搭了另一个女人Hsing。当她再次进入阿霞并决定赢回她时,一个致命的三角关系就会发展出来。)

programme.title: Five Superfighters ((唐山五虎))
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their masters birthday. (一个功夫大师和他的三个学生在被一个恶霸压倒之后失去了一切。 为了报复,学生们找到了向其他武术大师学习的方法,并在六个月后回来,在他们的恶霸生日上与恶霸重新比赛。)

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island ((兰屿之歌))
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him (他博士搬到台湾海岸边边边远的兰玉岛,寻找他长期失去的父亲,并开始经营一个诊所,治疗在那里被致命的红虫咬伤的岛民。他遇到了在诊所做护士的雅兰,他爱上了他。他作为嫉妒的岛民阴谋,他变得邪恶。)

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis ((血海螳螂仇))
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death. (冯皇帝命令冯皇帝在他家寻找天主造反的证据。 冯王爱上天斯孙女并娶她。 当他找到证据并试图与她离开时,他的妻子在与天王的战斗中丧生。 冯王创造了象一样的武术,并誓言为她的死报仇。)

programme.title: River of Tears (眼的河)
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living... (退休歌手和丈夫和儿子生活得很快乐.悲剧发生在她过去的一个男人回来追捕她时.在随后的斗争中,为了摆脱她的手,她的丈夫在车祸中死亡.被她的岳父指责为丈夫的死亡,被赶出房子,回到歌唱中以谋生.)

programme.title: Heroes of the East ((笕桥英烈传))
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge! (一位中国男子通过包办婚姻与一位日本妇女结婚,并设法侮辱她所有的日本武术家庭,向她提出了被其他人误解的挑战。 然后,他必须证明,通过与七位日本武术艺术家进行一系列决斗,来迎接挑战,中国功夫到底有多棒!)

programme.title: Forever And Ever ((美少女电脑战队 FOREVER AND EVER))
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a noblemans reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails. (艾维·林·波饰演一个年轻学者,被操纵嫁给一个贵族的不愿意女儿.结婚后,他很快发现了她的犹原因.她被传染性疾病击中.)

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio ((边城三侠))
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates! (一群农民被当地地方法官压迫,他们绑架了一名地方法官的女儿,希望当局听取他们的意见。 一个流浪的剑客向他伸出援手,帮助他。 两名战士从压迫者转向被压迫者。 三重战者反击地方法官。)

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: Raw Courage ((虎胆))
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies (在明皇被推翻,他的幼子被交给黑龙会照顾后,一个叛国武术部族攻击社会,迫使一对经验不足的剑士和剑士妇带着婴儿逃离。)

programme.title: Asia-pol ((午夜亚洲：美食·舞蹈·梦想))
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies. (亚洲刑警组织特工杨明春追踪一批走私黄金运给黑帮头目乔治·伊顿。他寻求一位中国妇女的帮助,她正试图为妹妹报仇,在关闭伊顿时,他躲过了几个致命的陷阱。这部间谍电影受到詹姆斯·邦德电影的启发。)

programme.title: Pursuit ((当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynastys Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge. (这部电影讲述了宋朝陆军总教官林宗的故事,他被一名腐败官员陷害,不得不开始充满危险的流亡。 在一位和尚的帮助下,林宗终于能够复仇。)

programme.title: The 82 Tenants ((82家房客))
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood? (继续经典喜剧"72人房"的成功,这部续集讲述了香港老建筑住户被开发商迫驱逐的故事.一些租户更喜欢接受补偿,而一些则反对此举.收购计划将破坏邻居的和吗?)

programme.title: The Happiest Moment ((一乐也))
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy. (这场色情喜剧的Anthlogic有三个故事:一个老人死于过量的病毒药丸;一个警察在向妓女勒索钱财后逃命;一个理发师学徒在夜间守夜时遇到活死人。 通过扮演所有这些角色,迈克尔·辉秀证明了自己是香港喜剧的天才。)

programme.title: The Lark (鱼)
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time. (六十年代流行歌星卡里·库扮演了小子, 在这个错误身份的浪漫剧中,)

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre ((魔殿屠龙))
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way! (被打败的恶棍成正舒返回,开始恐怖统治,困住一个美丽的蒙古公主,掌握阴阳结合,几乎无法战胜。 只有两把剑能挡住他的路!)

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler ((玉女嬉春))
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie. (导演伊诺伊·乌梅茨古在"黄"中迎接了夜总表演者的光世界.该电影描绘了两位歌唱妹妹,清平爱琳·陈·灵和挂贝蒂·廷·佩的斗争,并在新电影中被演出时结束.)

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber ((少林搭棚大师))
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu. (三部影片第二部,戈登·刘晓波剧《周任杰》,他假扮和尚,在少林省学习功夫,最终创造出自己的少林手架功夫风格。)

programme.title: Fast Fingers ((梁上君子))
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces! (比尔叔叔从监狱获释后,回来与过去的伙伴们一起发财。 他们继续利用那些不知情的公众,但受到正直的警察局长的密切监视,他恰好是比尔斯叔叔侄女之一的男朋友!)

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss ((掌门人))
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the schools honour. (Mei是一位年轻的海外中国妇女,她回到香港,接管了一所传统的武术学校。 她的现代管理风格与保守的高级门徒发生冲突,引发争议并吸引当地黑帮。 他们被迫抛开分歧,联合起来反击并捍卫学校的荣誉。)

programme.title: Passing Flickers ((三十年细说从头))
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado! (这部电影是香港电影行业的有趣的内幕人士看,基于导演李汉希安的热门报纸专,讲述了他在肖兄弟的作品.)

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2 ((倚天屠龙记大结局))
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuans original hit. (唯有将强大的天剑和强大的龙剑 联合起来 才能拯救六大武术宗派 争取至高无上)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive. (宋朝的王子被钦族入侵者抓获,由武术大师顶尖看守。 有两个强大的爱国者需要克服巨大的困难,拉出不可能的:拯救王储并活着离开钦族据点。)

programme.title: The Weird Man ((我家来了个怪男人))
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che. (在三大王国期间,一位道士刘智祭司用超自然的力量治愈了许多病人,并受到人民的爱戴。然而,傲慢的孙子将军切却认为,于智巫师会将人斩首,并命令他斩首。 随后,于智的精神从他的尸体上升起,对孙哲进行报复。)

programme.title: Kuttram 23
programme.desc: ACP Vetrimaaran unravels a crime racket involving medical professionals. However, his task becomes harder every day as the case becomes murkier and complex.

programme.title: Thirunaal
programme.desc: Blade, a henchman for a local gangster, Naaga, falls in love with Vidhya, the daughter of a factory owner. He has to choose between supporting her father and his boss, who are rivals.

programme.title: Pheonix
programme.desc: Young Surya, accused of political murder, endures deadly plots in a juvenile reform school while struggling to survive the brutal realities of life behind bars daily.

programme.title: House Mates
programme.desc: Newlyweds Karthik and Anu move into an old apartment where strange events disrupt their lives, pushing them to uncover a paranormal mystery linked to another nearby family.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: A street musician discovers he can glimpse couples futures when they kiss. When a vision reveals his love, he races to defy destiny and change it.

programme.title: Karumegangal Kalaigindrana
programme.desc: The Story is about Human Emotions and how to value the family when they are within reach NOT after you realize you had lost. A family without a strong foundation and values will disintegrate.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Kamali From Nadukaveri
programme.desc: Kamali, a young woman, strives hard to land a seat in a prestigious educational institute. Her journey soon inspires others from her small village to follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: Deiva Machan
programme.desc: Karthi is guided by visions of a man on a white horse as he strives to arrange his sisters marriage. However, an ominous prophecy soon unfolds, bringing unexpected troubles his way.

programme.title: Kalki 2898 Ad
programme.desc: The future of those in the dystopian city of Kasi is altered when the destined arrival of Lord Vishnus final avatar launches a war against darkness.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Mohini
programme.desc: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, an engaged couple, face chaos when Vaishnavi is possessed by a vengeful lookalike, threatening their relationship and future.

programme.title: Thiru Manickam
programme.desc: A man who is getting chased by everyone for doing good, yet he overcomes opposition. Among everyone who is trying to survive, this man wants to live. Shows how Manikkam becomes Thiru Manikkam

programme.title: Vinodhaya Sitham
programme.desc: Thambi Ramiahs calm life flips after death and resurrection. Granted a 3-month extension by time to settle his affairs, he faces if and how he succeeds.

programme.title: Gorilla
programme.desc: Jeeva and friends plan a bank heist with a chimpanzee. Hilarity ensues as their plan spirals into chaos, delivering laughs and unexpected twists along the way.

programme.title: J Baby
programme.desc: Volatile mother leaves family without notice. Sons embark on journey to find her, bringing family drama to light.

programme.title: Annapoorani
programme.desc: A girl born in an orthodox family aspires to become Indias best chef. She faces events and challenges on her way and goes beyond her conventional beliefs and prejudices to achieve her dream.

programme.title: Thunder
programme.desc: A CBI officer gains consciousness after being in coma and finds everyone referring to him as Godse. He discovers that it is a trap set up by a CM.

programme.title: Killadi Marumagan
programme.desc: Chaitu and Anu fall in love but their love is opposed by Anus mother, Shailaja Reddy, a woman who is determined to get her daughter married to the man of her choice.

programme.title: Bimbisara
programme.desc: Betrayed by his brother, an ancient evil emperor is trapped in a mirror and transported to the modern world, where he desperately searches for the mirror to return to his kingdom.

programme.desc: A series of spectacular evil crimes has risen and former super-villain Gru has been recruited to find out who is responsible for them. (一系列壮观的邪恶罪行已经升起,前超级恶棍格鲁被招募,)

programme.title: Despicable Me 3 ((神偷奶爸3))
programme.desc: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru finds himself in a major identity crisis until the appearance of a mysterious stranger reminds him how good it feels to be bad. (格鲁被解雇了,他发现自己处于一个严重的身份危机,直到一个神秘的陌生人出现,)

programme.title: Dracula Untold ((德古拉元年))
programme.desc: The origin story of the man who became Dracula. Vlad III, Prince of Wallachia, enters into a Faustian pact to save his people and becomes inflicted with an insatiable thirst for human blood. (瓦拉基亚王子弗拉德三世,签署了法乌斯斯协议,拯救他的人民,)

programme.title: Harry Potter And The Deathly Hallows - Part 1 ((哈利·波特与死亡圣器（上）))
programme.desc: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave Hogwarts behind on a mission to destroy the Horcruxes, the secrets to Voldemorts power and immortality. (哈利,罗恩和赫米昂离开霍格沃茨, 为了摧毁霍克鲁克斯,)

programme.title: Harry Potter And The Deathly Hallows - Part 2 ((哈利·波特与死亡圣器（下）))
programme.desc: The time has come, the fate foretold in the prophecy draws near: the confrontation to the death between Harry Potter and Lord Voldemort. (时间到了,预言中的命运即将到来:哈利·波特和伏尔德莫特之间的死亡对抗.)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! To The Movies ((少年泰坦出击电影版))
programme.desc: The Teen Titans head to Tinsel Town to pursue their dream of starring in their own movies. (青少年巨人前往城,追求自己的电影演出梦想.)

programme.title: Bad News Bears ((小熊成军))
programme.desc: A hot-headed baseball coach finds his work cut out when he takes upon a new coaching assignment with a team that is way below par. (一个热门的棒球教练在接受一个与队伍相差的新教练任务时发现他的工作已经被削减了.)

programme.title: Chocolat ((巧克力情人))
programme.desc: A woman opens a chocolate shop in a French town and creates confections that inspire the straitlaced villagers to abandon themselves to temptation and happiness. (一位妇女在法国一座镇开设了一家巧克力店,)

programme.title: Wanted ((通缉))
programme.desc: A clerk with no future finds his world tossed upside down after he joins a secret group of assassins when he discovers he has special powers. (一个没有前途的职员发现他的世界颠倒了 因为他加入了一个秘密的刺客小组 当他发现自己有特殊的能力时)

programme.title: Mission: Impossible The Final Reckoning ((碟中谍8：最终清算))
programme.desc: Our lives are the sum of our choices. Tom Cruise is Ethan Hunt in Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning. (我们的生命是我们选择的总数. 姆克鲁兹是伊丹亨特在"任务:不可能 - 最终的清算".)

programme.title: Hollywood On Set ((中文))
programme.desc: Each week Hollywood On Set goes behind-the-scenes on three major movies in production, featuring action footage and interviews with filmmakers. (每周,好莱在舞台上播放了三部主要电影,其中包括动作片段和与电影制作人进行的采访.)

programme.title: Rob Peace ((被盗的和平))
programme.desc: The true story of Robert Peace who grew up in New Jersey, the son of a convicted murderer, and defied the odds and went to Yale on a full scholarship. But at age 30, his bright future was ended by the bullet of a rival gang dealer. (罗伯特·和平(Robert Peace)的真实故事是在新泽西长大的,他是一名被判有罪的杀人犯的儿子,他不顾胜算,以全额奖学金进入耶鲁大学。 但30岁时,他的光明未来被一个对立帮派毒贩的子弹击中而结束。)

programme.title: Gray Matter (灰物质)
programme.desc: 16-year-old Aurora longs for a normal life - but must first learn to control her psychic powers. (16岁的Aurora希望过正常的生活,但必须首先学会控制她的超能力。)

programme.title: Smurfs ((蓝精灵))

programme.title: Planet Earth ((地球脉动))
programme.desc: The Tibetan fox and Mongolian gazelle are captured on film for the first time, while a 30-strong pride of lions hunt for elephants. (西藏狐狸和蒙古瞪羚首次被拍摄在电影中, 30人以狮子为荣,)

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs ((与恐龙同行))
programme.desc: The tale of the colossal Lusotitan. Living 150 million years ago on an island known as the Iberian Mesta, now in Portugal, this 25-metre-long titan dwarfed every other dinosaur in the region. (伟大的Lusotitan的故事。1.5亿年前生活在一个名为Iberian Mesta的岛上,现在葡萄牙的这个称为Iberian Mesta的岛屿上,这只25米长的泰坦龙比该地区其他恐龙都长。)

programme.title: Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle ((Ben Fogle - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Ben heads to an island at the edge of the world on Norways arctic coastline, and meets Elena, a former Middle East peacekeeper who has created her dream home here. (本前往一个位于世界边缘的岛屿 位于挪威的北极海岸线 并遇见了Elena 一位前中东维和人员)

programme.title: Asia (亚洲)
programme.desc: Many passionate people are dedicated to saving the wild animals of Asia. These individuals and their ingenious solutions give us hope and optimism for the future of the continent. (许多热情人士致力于拯救亚洲野生动物,这些人及其巧妙的解决方案给我们带来了对非洲大陆未来的希望和乐观.)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: X-man James Marsden joins Bear on an adventure into the heart Rattle Snake Canyon in Utah, where they helicopter on to one of the highest arches in the area. (Xman James Marsden 和熊一起探险 进入犹他州的Rattle蛇峡谷 在那里他们乘坐直升机 前往该地区最高拱门之一)

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs ((与恐龙同行))

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Actor Michael B. Jordan joins Grylls in Wales where they start their journey by dropping into rough waters off the coast before making their way up the coast and to the top of the mountains for their exit. (演员Michael B. Jordan加入威尔士的Grylls, 他们从那里开始旅程,)

programme.title: Deadly 60 ((致命的60种生物))
programme.desc: Steve Backshall goes searching for venomous snakes, bears and a cave dragon. (史提夫回去找毒蛇 熊和洞龙)

programme.title: Deadly 60 ((致命的60种生物))
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Timor Leste in search of the biggest animal to have ever lived - the blue whale. (Steve Backshall前往东帝汶 寻找有史以来最大的动物 蓝鲸)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s))
programme.desc: Robson and his uncle Matheson discover Hepple Estate in Northumberland and learn how to paint with pheasant feathers. They track wildlife before attempting to learn some circus skills. (罗布森和他的叔叔马西森发现了北安伯兰的赫普尔庄园,学习如何用野鸡羽毛来绘画。他们在试图学习马戏团技能之前跟踪野生动物。)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s))
programme.desc: The Rev Richard Coles joins Robson to explore the Northumberland coastline. They take a Canadian canoe trip along the River Coquet, visit the hidden gem of Walkworths secret hermitage, make the crossing to Lindisfarne for a photography class and have a go at rope work. (理查德·科尔斯牧师和罗伯森一起探索北南海岸。他们沿科克特河乘加拿大独木舟旅行,参观沃克沃斯隐秘的隐蔽宝石,前往林迪斯法恩上摄影课,并修绳索。)

programme.title: Engineering Repurposed ((牛来))
programme.desc: Stroll through a public park that was once a New York rail line and a church that was transformed into a thriving community hub. (走过一个曾经是纽约铁路线的公园和一个已变成繁荣社区中心的教堂.)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Actor Ed Helms faces sheer cliffs, crumbling rock and a cringeworthy dinner menu while atop Colorado mountains Helms discusses the road to his career in comedy. (爱德·赫尔姆斯在科罗拉多山脉上讨论他走向喜剧生涯的道路。)

programme.title: Rare Survivors - Chinas Iconic Wildlife ((最美华夏：中国的野生国宝))
programme.desc: Mist swirls around the base of Shanghais skyline. From the city, tigers and monkeys seem as unreal and distant as dragons and mermaids emerging through the mist. Yet they exist as rare survivors in an extraordinary and diverse landscape. From snow leopards to wild horses, and from alligators to elephants, Chinas iconic wildlife is a lot more than just pandas. (上海山顶的云雾环绕着上海的天空线。 从城市看,老虎和猴子似乎和龙和美人鱼一样不真实和遥远。 然而,它们却像稀有的幸存者一样存在于不同寻常的地貌中。 从雪豹到野马,从鳄鱼到大象,中国的象形野生动物远不止是熊猫。)

programme.title: Extreme Treks (极端的行程)
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Southeast Asia lies a region of rugged geography home to a diverse mix of people. A world apart from the rest of Myanmar, the Chin Hills are crossed by walking trails and paths. (东南亚的核心深处是一个厚的地理区域,这里有多种不同的人口.)

programme.title: Ancient Powers ((亘古文明))
programme.desc: In a world where enemies watch for weakness, our ancient powers must use all their strength and cunning to defend their people and conquer new lands. Who will rise to the challenge of the battlefield. (在一个敌人眼睁睁看着软弱的世界里,我们的古代强国必须利用他们的一切力量和狡猾,捍卫他们的人民,征服新的土地。 他们将奋起迎接战场的挑战。)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Actor Ed Helms faces sheer cliffs, crumbling rock and a cringeworthy dinner menu while atop Colorado mountains Helms discusses the road to his career in comedy. (爱德·赫尔姆斯在科罗拉多山脉上讨论他走向喜剧生涯的道路。)

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist (疯子:从雾中流)
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summers soundtrack or go silent forever. (与生物学家一起争取时间,因为他们试图弄清楚为什么北美的野猪突然处于危险之中。 解开这些可爱鸟的神秘生命,思考它们的呼声是继续是夏季声道还是永远沉默下去。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Wild Sky ((中文))
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations. (观察永恒的对水的探索,它决定了非洲野生动物的生活。 见证了地球上最大的海洋饲料狂热,看到眼镜蛇是如何靠太阳能储存的,并加入野生动物和大象部落的史诗迁徙。)

programme.title: Wild Sky ((中文))
programme.desc: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays. (了解南美洲丰富的气候多样性如何刺激更加丰富的生活多样性。 研究亚马逊雨林的氧气-呼吸树,沿着巨大的云层河流的弧线走下去,并迎接在紫外线燃烧的太阳中繁衍的火烈鸟。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating. (北方团队研究年轻黑人如何学习社交和生存技能。 然后和南方团队一起匆忙前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望看到沙虎鲨鱼最难以捉摸的行为:交配。)

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate. (以急诊队的形式,急转直下,病人会从春季涌入。当救援队躲避无礼的袋鼠时,看Phil的兽医如何稳定病痛。 影视高级兽医Tim治疗一只猫的摇摇欲坠的摇头丸,将一只小鹿从高架上划出来。)

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story (子:洞穴故事)
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests. (向一个独特的禽族家庭稳步前进的鼓棒前进。 了解世界239个木匠物种,从大到小,为什么大自然是最优秀的动物 探索它们的飞行、攀登和呼唤技巧, 并查看它们的秘密巢穴。)

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist (疯子:从雾中流)
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summers soundtrack or go silent forever. (与生物学家一起争取时间,因为他们试图弄清楚为什么北美的野猪突然处于危险之中。 解开这些可爱鸟的神秘生命,思考它们的呼声是继续是夏季声道还是永远沉默下去。)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter. (前往Samburu, 在那里,当权者Anastasia在当地河流干涸后将大象向北放牧。然后在Naboisho,看到印度豹妈妈Kuleta躲过了一群狡猾的土狼。 后来在Laikipia, 检查了野狗凤凰和她的新的垃圾。)

programme.title: Wild Sky ((中文))
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating. (北方团队研究年轻黑人如何学习社交和生存技能。 然后和南方团队一起匆忙前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望看到沙虎鲨鱼最难以捉摸的行为:交配。)

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate. (以急诊队的形式,急转直下,病人会从春季涌入。当救援队躲避无礼的袋鼠时,看Phil的兽医如何稳定病痛。 影视高级兽医Tim治疗一只猫的摇摇欲坠的摇头丸,将一只小鹿从高架上划出来。)

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story (子:洞穴故事)
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests. (向一个独特的禽族家庭稳步前进的鼓棒前进。 了解世界239个木匠物种,从大到小,为什么大自然是最优秀的动物 探索它们的飞行、攀登和呼唤技巧, 并查看它们的秘密巢穴。)

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist (疯子:从雾中流)
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summers soundtrack or go silent forever. (与生物学家一起争取时间,因为他们试图弄清楚为什么北美的野猪突然处于危险之中。 解开这些可爱鸟的神秘生命,思考它们的呼声是继续是夏季声道还是永远沉默下去。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter. (前往Samburu, 在那里,当权者Anastasia在当地河流干涸后将大象向北放牧。然后在Naboisho,看到印度豹妈妈Kuleta躲过了一群狡猾的土狼。 后来在Laikipia, 检查了野狗凤凰和她的新的垃圾。)

programme.title: Planet Shark ((鲨鱼星球))
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail. (鲨鱼在捕猎时用高温感官和杀手本能跟踪海洋。 观察白礁鲨鱼用电感应器探寻猎物心跳,中上层鲨鱼用鞭子尾巴捕捉采石场。)

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部)
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives. (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.)

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部)
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales. (为了争取河流的统治,与鱼一起战斗,然后看一条极为罕见的树蛇和一条危险的纳巴勒克鱼.)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins. (前往澳洲鲨鱼高速公路的终点。 查查南方的格林利岛是否是 迁徙大白鲨的卡车站,)

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble. (和救世主Jo一起去挖一个吞下鱼钩的子 然后看到Sam放了一只被围在围栏里的新生蝙蝠)

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 스위치
programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot
